## Usage

```text
provenance component <command>
```

Manage component repositories composed into this one as git submodules under `SUBCOMPONENTS/`. Each operation produces an ordinary, reviewable commit.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`component add`]({{< relref "component-add.md" >}}) | Register a component repository as a submodule |
| [`component remove`]({{< relref "component-remove.md" >}}) | Remove a component submodule |
| [`component update`]({{< relref "component-update.md" >}}) | Move a pinned component to a different commit |
